items.title: Welsh & Shedar Anime Launches Webtoon
items.summary: 12-episode webtoon features multiple artists // French entertainment company Ankama announced on Wednesday that a 12-episode webtoon adaptation of the...
items.text:
Ankama a annoncé le lancement d’un webtoon de douze épisodes inspiré de la série "Welsh & Shedar". Le projet réunit plusieurs artistes autour d’une adaptation qui prolongera l’univers de l’anime. Les premiers chapitres seront publiés en ligne, offrant aux fans une nouvelle façon de découvrir l’histoire.

items.title: Roundtable: Bartosz Sztybor on Potential Edgerunners Season 3, Retelling David and Lucy's Relationship, and Roman's Personal Inspirations
items.summary: Interview Roundtable: Bartosz Sztybor on Potential Edgerunners Season 3, Retelling David and Lucy’s Relationship, and Roman’s Personal Inspirations Written by Jorge Manuel Sanchez Moreno Cardenas November 12, 2026 Following the CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 2 panel at Lucca Comics & Games, we sat down with showrunner Bartosz Sztybor to talk even deeper about Season 2 and its connection to other elements of the franchise. We talked about the creation process with Studio TRIGGER, how he deals with Cyberpunk ‘s lore, and his insight into Roman, D, Capri, and other characters. Bartosz, who also writes the manga Cyberpunk: Edgerunners MADNESS with illustrator Asano, also commented on the connections between the different Cyberpunk media. Just as in our previous interview about Season 1 , we had a great time talking with Sztybor about the reasoning behind his writing decisions. With his particular humor, he is always open to sharing his thoughts—even at the risk of spoilers. Portions of this roundtable have been edited for clarity. Beware of CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 1 and 2 plot spoilers below. IGN: Given what you were talking about on the panel today, what are your thoughts right now on a potential Season 3? items.text:
À l’issue du panel "CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 2" au Lucca Comics & Games, le showrunner Bartosz Sztybor a évoqué la possibilité d’une troisième saison. Il a également abordé la façon dont la relation entre David et Lucy pourrait être revisitée et les inspirations personnelles qui nourrissent le personnage de Roman. L’interview, publiée par Anime Corner, donne un aperçu des réflexions de l’équipe sur la suite de la franchise.

Question à la communauté : Pensez‑vous que la saison 3 d’Edgerunners verra le jour ?

items.text:
Le média ToutenBD.com rapporte le décès de Frédéric Boilet, l’un des défenseurs les plus influents du manga d’auteur. Son travail a marqué le paysage du dessin animé et du comics, et il était reconnu pour son engagement en faveur d’une approche plus personnelle et artistique du médium.

items.title: Le géant du manga Shueisha annonce Nightmare Operator, un TPS horrifique avec combos de versus fighting - Gamekult
items.text:

items.title: Bartosz Sztybor and Saya Elder on Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2's Emotional Impact
items.summary: Events Press Conference Bartosz Sztybor and Saya Elder on Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2’s Emotional Impact Written by Jorge Manuel Sanchez Moreno Cardenas November 11, 2026 CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 2 left no one indifferent after the worldwide release of the ten-episode season on October 20. The latest installment is a new story in the noir world of Night City after the events of Season 1, with a whole new set of characters and ideas on the table brought to life again by Studio TRIGGER and CD PROJEKT RED (CDPR). Following the premiere, Season 2’s showrunner Bartosz Sztybor and executive producer Saya Elder from CDPR flew to the Italian festival Lucca Comics & Games and took part in a special panel on the third day of the convention, October 30, in Cinema Astra. Under the name “Emotional Damage: How Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Makes You Feel,” both guests spoke with journalist Eva Carducci about the decisions behind the new season, and the emotions they put into the show. Portions of this panel have been edited for clarity. Beware of CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 1 and 2 plot spoilers below. Q: How do you make people emotional? Bartosz: Honestly I don’t know. It just happens. What needs to be done is that the creators need to be sincere with themselves. That’s why I always put myself into the characters that I’m creating. It’s also important that when I write stories, they are always character driven. The plot is important, of course. But the character is the most important thing in the plot.
